alex: hi everyone, day 1 here. trying to get a single dev setup for python/node/go/rust on an Intel MBP. getting build errors when installing python via asdf (openssl-related). any fast checklist or gotchas?

devex: welcome alex! :wave: our condensed checklist for Intel macs: 1) Homebrew, 2) asdf + plugins, 3) git + gitconfig, 4) 1Password CLI, 5) Docker, 6) rustup (for local rust). Most python build failures are missing brew openssl headers.

sara: agreed. for the openssl issue try this before `asdf install python`: 
```bash
brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config
export LDFLAGS="-L/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"
# then re-run asdf install
```
That fixed it for me on Intel.

alex: nice — thanks. what's our pattern for .tool-versions and dotfiles?

devex: we prefer per-repo .tool-versions checked into the repo. For personal machine, keep a local `~/.tool-versions-local` in your dotfiles (not checked in). Add plugins first: `asdf plugin-add python nodejs golang rust` and for nodejs follow the gpg key step in the plugin docs.

sara: for nodejs also make sure to `brew install gpg` so the nodejs plugin can verify releases. then `asdf install nodejs 18.16.0` (or whatever version your repo uses). If you use yarn via corepack: `npm i -g corepack && corepack enable`.

alex: dotfiles — we use zsh. any recommended snippets?

devex: typical dotfiles setup: keep personal secrets out of the repo. symlink configs from `~/dotfiles/*` into home. Example .zshrc snippet: 
```bash
# 1password CLI and op setup
eval "$(op signin --raw)" 2>/dev/null || true
export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"
eval "$(asdf init -)"
```
Also add `direnv`/`.envrc` integration per-project for env vars.

alex: ssh/gpg for signing commits and forwarding?

sara: generate an ed25519 SSH key and a separate gpg key for signing if you want. We use 1Password SSH agent on Mac sometimes. Example ssh config to enable forwarding & keychain: 
```bash
Host *
  AddKeysToAgent yes
  UseKeychain yes
  ForwardAgent yes
```
And `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. For git commit signing, set `user.signingkey` and `commit.gpgsign` in global gitconfig.

ops-bot: reminder: new hires must request access to the "Redwood - Developer Secrets" 1Password vault if not already added.

devex: for local dev creds: we typically set REDWOOD_API_KEY (staging), REDWOOD_ENV=development, REDWOOD_REGION=us-east-1. Put these in project `.envrc` and load via direnv, not in dotfiles.

alex: thanks folks — python build succeeded after the openssl env vars. moving on to node/yarn. will ping if stuck. :raised_hands:
